data.one_liner: Dart implementation of a mustache subset for simple String templates with filters.
data.what_it_does: It implements a subset of the mustache specification for Dart to process simple string templates. It supports filters and implements the dart:convert specification.
use_when: You need basic mustache string templating in your Dart application
You want to render templates using the dart:convert pattern
avoid_when: You need full mustache specification support with all advanced features
You require complex logic beyond simple variable substitution and filters
weaknesses: Only implements a subset of mustache templates
data.minimal_example:
final m = Mustache(map: {'name': 'David'});
final output = m.convert('Hello, my name is {{ name }}.');
